response.overview: In a remote village in western Ireland, lonely Maureen Folan lives with her demanding and manipulative mother, Mag. When Maureen begins a relationship with a local man and glimpses the possibility of a life beyond their claustrophobic home, the fragile balance between mother and daughter begins to collapse.
response.tagline: A chance at escape. A mother determined to stop it.
response.title: The Beauty Queen of Leenane
